'''January 2002 Wenatchee tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Wenatchee Sports Cards, Wenatchee, Washington on 19 January 2002. Casey won it. It is known from Ryan French's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3283">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-21-wenatchee-wa-1-19-02-episode-1-onlyd3283/ wenatchee-wa-1-19-02-episode-1-only], DeckTech (Ryan "Shadow 13" French, 21 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-21-wenatchee-wa-1-19-02-episode-1-onlyd3283/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 January 2002
* '''Site:''' Wenatchee Sports Cards, Wenatchee, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' Casey
